english.meaning: good-looking, said of a girl or young woman
english.note: Often used as 唔靚女 or 靚女 + 嘅 to say a girl is or isn't good-looking.

exampleSentences.english: Oh, so you’re saying Sprite isn’t pretty.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哦你即係話雪碧唔靚女嘅。
exampleSentences.jyutping: o3 nei5 zik1 hai6 waa6 syut3 bik1 m4 leng3 neoi2 ge3

exampleSentences.english: So you’re saying she’s pretty, is that it?
exampleSentences.traditional: 你即係話佢靚女啫噉樣？
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zik1 hai6 waa6 keoi5 leng3 neoi2 ze1 gam2 joeng2
